prompts.wall: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating 2D side-scroller game material tile. Reference images are STYLE AND MATERIAL references only. Match the cutscene's handcrafted detailed pixel-art Victorian haunted-house interior, restrained warm amber and walnut colors, deep brown outlines, muted cool blue-gray shadow accents, crisp pixel clusters. FLAT orthographic material swatch filling the ENTIRE square edge to edge, seamless on all edges, no perspective, no surrounding scene, no frame, no padding, no text, no objects, no dramatic local light source or gradients. Opaque background. Render as low resolution pixel art about 128x128 logical pixels. Moderate contrast so characters and hazards remain readable. Aged dusty taupe wallpaper with a small repeating Victorian floral pattern of faded burgundy flowers and dark olive leaves, subtle worn paper patina. Medium-dark desaturated taupe ground, matching the wallpaper behind the chair in the reference.
